description: This source file defines the SequencedIdToEnv class, which implements an entity operation for the MiniLang language in the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides functionality for generating sequence-based identifiers and storing them in the environment map within the context of a mini-language execution. The class handles attributes such as sequence name, field, whether to get a long ID only, and stagger maximum value, with methods to execute the ID generation logic.

classes.name: SequencedIdToEnv
classes.description: Implements an entity operation that generates sequence IDs and stores them in the environment map, based on attributes defined in an XML element.

classes.description: Factory class to create instances of SequencedIdToEnv from an XML element.
